name: [ROSE PACK] DM Arena
desc:
Magic | Deathmatch Arena

A GTA 5 FiveM - style PvP shooter focused on fast-paced gunfights, skill-based combat, and progression. Fight in an arena with realistic weapons, recoil, and competitive gameplay.

The game features an arena teleport, in-game shop, clan system, and advanced settings such as FOV, stretched resolution, Redux, and control customization.

The project is in active development. Bugs and test changes may occur.

Version 26.29.09 beta
Last update: 29 Sep, 2026

Controls (PC):
WASD — Move
Shift — Sprint
Right Mouse Button — Aim
R — Reload
C — Crouch
X — Whistle
1–9 — Switch weapons

Features:
Shop with weapons and gear, clan management, and a green zone where damage is disabled and items are temporarily removed.
